them.mo_ta: Red modern convertible motor car on the hillside.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: A modern motor car is incompatible with 1780; practical petrol automobiles appeared in the late nineteenth century.

them.mo_ta: Single standing or walking figure on the shore outside the foreground fortifications, wearing a blue coat, pale breeches and dark boots, apparently carrying a sword.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: The clothing appears broadly period-compatible, but this is an invented military-looking figure absent from the ground truth, prohibited by the supplied N2+ rule against invented troops.

them.mo_ta: Large square-rigged wooden warship with deployed pale sails and multiple rows of gunports, added in the foreground water.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: The vessel is broadly compatible with the age of sail, but it is wholly invented relative to BEFORE and therefore violates the supplied N2+ prohibition on invented sailing ships.

them.mo_ta: Union-pattern flag at the stern of the added foreground warship; its diagonals appear to include red crosses.
them.ly_do_thoi_dai: The visible pattern appears to be the post-1801 Union Flag with the red diagonal saltire of St Patrick, which would be too late for 1780. The very small flag limits certainty.
